verdicts.reason: A and B are pixel-identical, so this is a tie. Both have the same flaws. The bottle hangs alone on the left, leaving a large dead area in the centre and right. The legal text is squeezed into a narrow 6-line column at the bottom right, tiny and hard to read, sitting at the same level as the CTA. The body copy wraps into a cramped 4-line block beside the button, so the bottom is jammed and the middle is empty. The headline is oversized, the sale ribbon floats off to the right, and the original's centred reading order (headline, copy, CTA) is broken.
